name: activate_sepsis_protocol
description: Activate the sepsis bundle protocol (SEP-1) for early recognition and treatment of sepsis and septic shock

altered_mental_status.description: Whether patient has altered mental status

blood_cultures_drawn.description: Whether blood cultures have been obtained

fluid_resuscitation_ml.description: Volume of IV fluids administered in mL

when_to_use: Patient meeting qSOFA criteria (altered mentation, RR ≥22, SBP ≤100)
Suspected infection with evidence of organ dysfunction
Lactate level ≥ 2 mmol/L with suspected infection
Hypotension not responding to initial fluid bolus
Post-surgical patient with signs of systemic inflammatory response

examples.query: Elderly patient with UTI, confused, blood pressure 85/50, lactate 4.2
Post-operative patient with fever, tachycardia, and rising WBC count
